newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude stuck in 18.96-20.07 range.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude stuck in 18.96-20.07 range.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
----------------- VIEWS FROM THE MARKET - APRIL 18 -----------
+ NYMEX crude rangebound with key resistance and support
remaining at $18.96 and $20.
+ Heat capped by 53.20 and 53 cents, faces resistance at 55.20
cents.
+ Gasoline needs to break 62.25/30 cents area to head higher.
NYMEX crude on Friday was expected to stay firmly within the $1.0 range it has frequented for the last two weeks , with few chartists expecting any fireworks ahead of the weekend.
May closed seven cents higher at $19.42 a barrel on Thursday having fallen as low as $19.10 during the session.
For most chartists the double bottom put in at $18.96 last week would continue to support the market, while key resistance was pegged around $20.
"I think the two significant numbers are $19.10 and $18.96," said a Washington-based chartist.
"We could see it dip below there slightly but I don't know if we'll see it accelerating from there," she said.
On the upside, she noted targets of $19.85 in line with where moving averages cut the chart and $20.09 in line with Tuesday's high.
"I think if it clear $20.09 we could see some substantial gains thereafter," she said.
"I think we're going to see more range trading," said Charles Gray at Prudential Bache in London.
May heat was closed 0.52 cent higher at 54 cents a gallon on Thursday, but last traded at 54.30 on ACCESS trading.
Some chartists saw support for the contract around the double bottom at the 53.20 cents level seen on April 16 and 17 and below there at 53 cents.
On upward front, resistance was seen at 55.20 cents in line with the double top seen on April 11 and 15.
May gasoline ended Thursday's session a 0.32 cent at 60.70 and last traded on ACCESS at 61.15 cents a gallon.
Gasoline was also seen stuck in range with support pegged at around 59.60/90 in line with recent lows at that level.
On the up side, resistance was pegged at 61.50 and then 62.25/30 in line with highs seen recently.
-- Melanie Goodfellow, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7714.
